title: Notice served by a bailiff before a claim for rescission

expect.why: 119 ¶1: the other party may demand execution or rescission 'بعد اعذاره المدين'. A notice was served before filing, by a bailiff, which is the plain form of 'انذار' (180 ¶1).

title: Notice by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt before a claim for damages

expect.why: 180 ¶1: 'يجوز أن يتم الاعذار عن طريق البريد على الوجه المبين في هذا القانون'; the registered letter is the postal means. 179 ¶1 requires notice before damages, and it was given.

title: No notice at all, claim for damages, no exemption fact known

expect.why: 179 ¶1: 'لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد اعذار المدين ما لم يوجد نص مخالف'. No notice was sent. The exemptions of 181 depend on facts no slot holds (see reply), so the case assumes none applies.

title: No notice, claim for rescission of a bilateral contract

expect.why: 119 ¶1: rescission may be demanded 'بعد اعذاره المدين'; none was given. The contract date does not change the need for notice.

title: Notice step unknown, claim for damages and rescission

expect.why: Whether a notice was sent is not stated; a missing fact is not a 'no'. The rule must ask notice_served before deciding.

title: Notice sent by an unlisted means

expect.why: 180 ¶1 says notice is by 'انذاره، أو بما يقوم مقام الانذار', by post, or by agreement. The text does not say which other means 'stand in for' a notice (e.g. an e-mail or a message); the text does not settle this. The rule must warn, not decide.

title: The notice is dated after the petition

expect.why: 119 ¶1 and 179 ¶1 speak of the claim 'بعد اعذاره'/'إلا بعد اعذار': the notice must come first. A notice dated 2026-06-20 does not precede a petition of 2026-06-15, so the prior step was not done in time. The texts do not state a time limit between notice and claim.

title: Notice dated on the petition day itself

expect.why: The texts require notice before the claim ('بعد اعذار') but do not say whether a notice of the same day suffices; the text does not settle this.

title: Rescission clause in the contract, no notice sent

expect.why: 120 ¶1 allows an agreement that the contract is rescinded by law, but 120 ¶2: 'وهذا الشرط لا يعفي من الاعذار'. Such a clause does not exempt from notice, so no notice means the step is missing. The clause itself has no slot (see reply).

title: Claim only for payment of the price, no notice

expect.why: 119 ¶1 requires notice for demanding execution or rescission of a bilateral contract; 179 ¶1 requires it for damages. The texts do not say whether a payment claim on a contract is 'demand for execution', or on a debt not from a bilateral contract; the text does not settle this.

title: Eviction claim only, no notice, texts given silent

expect.why: The texts given govern notice for execution, rescission and damages; they do not say whether eviction is one of them, and any special notice to quit is not in these texts; the text does not settle this.
The notice was served but the means is missing; whether it is a notice (bailiff), postal (registered letter) or another means (180 ¶1) cannot be judged, so the rule must ask notice_means.
